::: {.mz-hero}
[I am a researcher at [AIT Austrian Institute of Technology](https://www.ait.ac.at/) in Vienna, working on system dynamics models of urban mobility, climate adaptation and mitigation, and how such models can support policy.]{.mz-lead}

[This site collects results and news from ongoing and recent projects, as well as notes and observations that do not fit into a deliverable.]{.mz-sub}
